name: Cost and Reliability
tagline: Balance route fees against failure risk.
brief: Use expected cost to choose among three online providers.
context: All providers are online, but their fees and success rates are different. A failure costs ₦5.
narrative:
Availability is no longer the problem. Provider A has the lowest fee but fails more often; Provider B is more reliable but costs more.

Compare expected cost instead of using fee or reliability alone. The correct route is the one that keeps the whole queue within budget.
objective: Process every payment and keep total cost at or below ₦3.00.
learningObjective: Use a composite expected-cost score to make a reliable cost decision.
intelligenceExplanation:
The provider cards display expected cost as fee plus expected failure cost. In this fixed setup, B has the lowest value.

Use that displayed fact to route the queue and then inspect the final cost in the debug panel.
hint: Choose the provider with the lowest displayed expected cost: WHEN onlineB → DO route-b.
